CASE 001

PERSONAL PUBLISHING PLATFORM

Rough at Sea

2026

R/S
FROM FULL-STACKTO STATIC-BY-DESIGN

THE SITUATION

A capable backend for a problem that no longer needed one.

The first version used Next.js, PostgreSQL, Google authentication, server actions, and object storage. It worked. But when the editorial direction changed, keeping that machinery would have meant maintaining complexity without earning value.

01

Preserve the learning

The complete application remains in Git history and under archive/, available as a technical reference without dictating the new structure.

02

Choose the smaller system

Astro generates the site as static HTML. Articles live beside the code in typed Markdown collections, and interactive JavaScript is opt-in.

03

Make the redesign visible

The new interface treats engineering notes as field reports: high-contrast typography, navigational instruments, and a precise editorial grid.
